title: You and Us
subtitle: And yet, trust was never given to us—not once.

items.text: You and Us

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: So, Lieutenant Bertolt briefed you on the real objective, and then you, Aleksei, and Hassan teamed up to carry out an independent operation. Is that correct?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: Very well, we'll corroborate your account with Aleksei's and Bertolt's.

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: And you hitting the Lieutenant—that really happened?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Yeah, I socked him good. I was gonna go for round two, but then Aleksei waltzed in and it wouldn't have been good form to deck your CO in front of the lads.
The interrogator struggled to stifle his chuckle.

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: You've certainly got spirit, Comrade Lilya.

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: Go on, then. What happened next? What did you three run into?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: After gearing up, Hassan led the way, Aleksei and I followed. The three of us headed deeper into the mountains.
In the Mountains, Juhalerat

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Watch your step, friends, don't let the thorns prick you.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: I can't believe you grew up in a place like this, Comrade Hassan.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: That's why I eventually left for the city to seek a different life. Haha!

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: I was the first from our village to go to the city! I've always been something of a pioneer, you know!
He radiates with pride. A mountain-born maverick, unyielding and audacious.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: We trekked through the mountains and wilderness, moving from tree to tree and slope to slope.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: We struggled to keep up with Hassan, whose nimble and sure movements resembled that of a mountain goat.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Hey, keep up! Am I going too fast, comrades? Should we take a breather?

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: A breather? Not a chance! Our comrades are waiting. Keep moving!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I'm fine.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Whenever there's fighting, the locals hide until it calms down, and then they come out.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: The more daring might strip the dead. A simple canteen can be a valuable find for a struggling family.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: This place is unbelievably poor.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Poor people have their ways. After all, this is the life we were all born into!

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: It was like this before you came, and it will be like this after you leave.
The words leave Aleksei disoriented, as if his passion had been poured onto the lifeless stones here, only to be met with indifference.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Stop. Hear that?

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Hm?
They stop. Lilya takes out the radar and checks their position.
They are getting closer to the signal.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Shh. Listen carefully, comrades. It's a faint woman's voice.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Do you have the ears of a fox, boy? Because I don't hear anything.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: That way! Move it! Someone might be able to help us with the herbs!

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Hey, slow down!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I ran after them. Aleksei sprinted into the distance, reaching the edge of the forest.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: It's you! I never expected to see you again!

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Are you okay? Hmm, it looks like you can walk now. Hassan, does she understand what I'm saying?
Hassan chambers his gun and cautiously approaches the woman.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Not this again, Hassan! We saved her before, and she's unarmed, just like last time!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan seemed to have a deep distrust of the mountain people.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I guess they marked him a traitor, you know, working for Zeno and all.
The armed man approaches, speaking the local dialect. He questions the woman, who utters a few words for him to translate.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: She needs money because her sheep were blown up. If you can pay her, she can help you find who you're looking for.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: How does she know we're looking for someone?
Hassan relays Lilya's message to the woman.
She speaks and gestures, tears falling, as if both crying and not crying.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: She saw people dressed like you enter the cave yesterday. Several of them.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: They were injured, and her sister is caring for them. She was too terrified to tell anyone ...

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Because the enemy would never spare her or her sister if they found out.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: After the mission, she could come back to the base with us. It wouldn't be hard for her to find work in the city.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Stop it with your excessive kindness, brother Aleksei. I'm begging you.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: If what she says is true, then Zeno is in her debt.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: *sigh* What do you think, little comrade?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan shirked the decision to me. My heart softened for a second, I guess, and I agreed with Aleksei.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: I should still have some money on me.
Rummaging his pockets, he pulls out a crumpled local banknote and hands it to the woman.
She hesitates, not wanting to accept.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Is she ashamed to take our money?

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: No, what you're giving her is worthless paper. Over here, you'll have to give her some "real" money.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Aw man. Guess I'll handle this.
Hassan reluctantly retrieves a crumpled bill from the sole of his shoe and hands it to the woman, uttering a few words.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Now she'll guide us.
Averting her eyes from Aleksei, the woman limps ahead. He wants to talk to her, they can't get past the language barrier.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: You see, Hassan? Being kind to the locals does pay off.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: With the support of the locals, Zeno's work here will be much smoother in the future.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: She's leading us the right way. In the right direction, at least.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: We're getting closer to the signal.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Will we find any herbs in the cave, Comrade Hassan?

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Yes, but not many. These plants prefer sunlight, so they should be mostly near the entrance and in the general vicinity.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Good, it seems we can accomplish two objectives with one action.
The young man is pleased that his earlier deeds have borne fruit.
Good deeds are rewarded, and evil deeds are punished. He firmly believes this.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: That cave is the one.
The four of them walk to the slope outside the cave, where several shell casings lie scattered about.
The woman speaks with Hassan briefly before limping into the cave by herself.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: She's asking us to wait while she confirms there's no one else inside.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Does she live around here? We didn't see any villages on the way here.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Who knows? She could be a refugee from anywhere. War is everywhere these days, not even the mountains is spared from its chaos.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: And women have particularly suffered in these tumultuous times.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: My wife was a refugee who fled from the north. We met after her escape, and we got married. She is such a good woman.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan spoke of his wife with the same pride as Aleksei spoke of his family.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: We waited for a few more minutes at the cave entrance.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: What if this is a trap?

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: What if she took my money and ran? That's my hard-earned cash!

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: When we get back, you two better vouch for me! I fronted cash for this mission! Zeno should reimburse me!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Just then, the woman came back out. She scoped around carefully before signaling for us to hurry over.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan led the way, Aleksei was in the middle, and I covered the rear.
Cave, Juhalerat

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: We entered the cave, flashlight in hand.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan was very cautious. He handed the flashlight to Aleksei, took out his gun and followed the woman closely.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Better stay sharp.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: There was a fight here.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The ground was littered with bodies and splatters, some of the dead stripped of their coats and boots.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: These were our guys. The enemy wouldn't be caught dead with these metal tags on their belts.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Were the ones who shot at us wearing clothes they took from here?

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Most likely.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Why can't I hear anyone else around?

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: It's odd. Our people wouldn't just leave their comrades behind.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan wanted sound, and sound he got.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: As we hit a fork in the cave, the woman let out a sudden yell and ran into the shadows.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I later learned the meaning of the word she kept yelling: "Revenge."

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: This can't be happening!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan pulled the trigger, the woman fell, and we were under fire.
